name: io.github.dortort/wawarden
title: WaWarden
description: Self-hosted WhatsApp gateway with per-client, per-chat scoped reading, search, and sending

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Scoped client bearer token created with 'wawarden admin clients create'

client_token.description: Client bearer token issued by 'wawarden admin clients create'

runtimeArguments.description: Mount the container root filesystem read-only; WaWarden writes only under /data

runtimeArguments.name: --publish
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the client MCP and REST listener on host loopback only

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Mount a named Docker volume on /data (inherits 65532:65532 mode 0700)

data_volume.description: Docker volume name for persistent archive, session store, and keys

environmentVariables.name: WAWARDEN_LISTEN
environmentVariables.description: Client listener address inside the container; bind 0.0.0.0:8080 so host loopback port publishing reaches it

environmentVariables.name: WAWARDEN_OWNER_PHONE
environmentVariables.description: WhatsApp account phone number in E.164 format permitted to pair (e.g. +15550100001)

environmentVariables.name: WAWARDEN_ADMIN_TOKEN_SHA256
environmentVariables.description: 64-hex-character SHA-256 hash of the admin token from 'wawarden admin init'; enables the admin listener

environmentVariables.name: WAWARDEN_ADMIN_LISTEN
environmentVariables.description: Admin listener address inside the container (default 127.0.0.1:8082)

environmentVariables.name: WAWARDEN_MEDIA_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum downloadable attachment size in bytes (0 disables media downloads; up to 2147483648)
